title: Phase A in the fixture method
body_md:
Phase A of the fixture takes a request for work and ends with an approved statement of work; nothing starts without the request. [ADM §3]

Its two objectives are a high-level vision of the value to be delivered and approval for the statement of work — **the vision is aspirational, the statement is the mandate**. [ADM §3.1]

The inputs are the request, the principles and a populated repository; the outputs are the approved statement and the vision. Trap: the request is an input, never an output. [ADM §3.3]

The steps run: establish the project, identify stakeholders and concerns (with a stakeholder map), define scope, then develop the vision and the statement. [ADM §3.4]

check_yourself.question: What does Phase A end with?
Is the request an input or an output?
